headline: Ratchet & Clank's native port gains music, speech and sharper menus
summary: Ratchet & Clank's native PAL port gains sound effects followed by music and speech streamed from the disc. Native textured UI quads and sharper text land in #6, while Linux gains the launcher Play action. Camera fixes address strafe-view blending, first-person initialisation and invalid collision bounds. Master continues direct development rather than its usual release-only workflow.
highlights: Pause menus keep the world image without the HUD and avoid black frames while opening and closing (#6).
Discord presence works on Windows and reports the game, planet, location and bolt count, with connection handling moved away from UI work.
Save-slot clock, planet and empty-state parsing are corrected, and the launcher adds Compact and Classic layout choices.
